newsitem.title: USA: U.S. durable goods orders drop sharply in March.
newsitem.headline: U.S. durable goods orders drop sharply in March.

text.p: Orders for costly manufactured goods were broadly lower in March, the Commerce Department said on Tuesday, dropping at the sharpest rate in seven months.

New orders for durable goods fell 3 percent last month to a seasonally adjusted $171.5 billion. It was the biggest monthly plunge since a 3.6 percent decrease in orders last August and a much weaker performance than anticipated by Wall Street economists, who had forecast no change from February's revised 0.8 percent gain.
